naiPrompt: Luxury villa living room, afternoon. Three gift boxes on white marble coffee table: pink box open with nail polish bottle, black long box open with wine-red gemstone choker necklace displayed, deep purple box open with amber crystal essential oil bottle. Lin Meng sitting at bar counter, one leg crossed over other, fox eyes half-closed with teasing smirk, wine-red wavy hair draped over right shoulder exposing left neck, finger pointing toward gemstone necklace on table. Lin Xiaoxiao sitting cross-legged on floor clutching pink nail polish bottle, blushing, silver bell choker on neck, white t-shirt and denim shorts, barefoot. Lin Yaru standing with amber oil bottle cradled in palm, thumb stroking crystal facets, gentle smile with knowing look, dark red silk robe, pearl necklace. Afternoon sunlight through floor-to-ceiling windows casting warm light, gift box ribbons draped on marble surface
